title.narrative: Establishing a Regional Early Warning Radiation Monitoring Network and Data Exchange Platform in ASEAN (MC3.01/19)

description.narrative: The scope of the contract includes the supply of equipment for national early warning radiation monitoring networks, and the establishment or enhancement of national early warning radiation monitoring networks in ASEAN Member States. This includes the installation and commissioning of the supplied equipment, training on its use, as well as maintenance and interpretation of the monitoring data. An ASEAN Radiological Data Exchange Platform (ASEAN-RDEP) to be established under this contract will allow the exchange of data between national networks.
